description: Clear the explicit viewport on the selected or first controlled browser page. Before any controlled page exists, clear the pending override without creating a page. Does not change page zoom, the capture surface, or native presentation birth size. Supply target_id to act on that exact already-owned page independently of the selected or displayed tab. Omit target_id to use the selected tab. With no selected or explicit target, a pending viewport intent is allowed only when the owned context has no pages.

target_id.description: Exact already-owned page returned by browser.tabs or browser.tab_new. This does not select, show, create, or focus that page.
